auth.login_intro: Andika izina ry’ukoresha n’ijambobanga rya JENESIS.
auth.setup_intro: Shyiraho ikigo n’konti ya mbere y’umuyobozi. Iyi ntambwe ikorwa rimwe gusa.

auth.unavailable_title: JENESIS ntiyashoboye kugera kuri serivisi yayo y’imbere

auth.recovery_link: Ntushobora kwinjira muri JENESIS yari isanzwe ikoreshwa?
auth.recovery_title: Kugarura uburenganzira bwo gukoresha JENESIS yari isanzweho
auth.recovery_intro: Ubu bubiko busanzwemo abakoresha cyangwa amakuru y’ubucuruzi. Kwandikisha umuyobozi wa mbere ntibyemewe kugira ngo ayo makuru arindwe.
auth.recovery_backup: Funga JENESIS ubanze ukore kopi y’ububiko bw’amakuru. Ntusibe ububiko cyangwa abakoresha basanzweho.
auth.recovery_steps: Niba hari umuyobozi ushobora kwinjira, yagukorera konti mu Igenamiterere. Bitabaye ibyo, saba umuyobozi wawe cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye uburenganzira gukurikiza uburyo bwo kugarura konti buri muri DESKTOP.md.
auth.recovery_warning: Kongera gushyiraho porogaramu ntibisiba amakuru yawe cyangwa ngo byongere gufungura iyandikwa rya mbere. Ntugahe umuntu utizeye ijambobanga cyangwa ububiko bw’amakuru.
auth.setup_complete_notice: Konti y’umuyobozi yakozwe. Injira ukoresheje izina n’ijambobanga wahisemo.

network.lan_unavailable: Gukoresha urusobe rwa LAN ntibirafungurwa muri iyi verisiyo. Ibyo ukoresha byose bikorera kuri serivisi y’iyi mudasobwa; ntugasangize izindi mudasobwa dosiye za database.

calculator.title: Imashini ibara
calculator.invalid: Genzura ibyo wanditse cyangwa kugabanya na zeru.
calculator.no_posting: Ikoreshwa mu kubara gusa; ntiyandika mu gitabo cy’ibaruramari.

help.title: Ikigo cy’ubufasha
help.intro: Uko wakoresha intambwe ku yindi ibice by’iyi porogaramu.
help.offline: Biri muri JENESIS: bikora nta murongo wa interineti.
help.no_guarantees: Ibi bisobanuro si inama y’ibaruramari, imisoro, amategeko cyangwa umutekano.

start.title: Gutangira
start.intro: Hitamo aho porogaramu itangirira mbere yo kwinjira.
start.step1: Fungura iy’Umugurisha (umutuku), iy’Umuyobozi (ubururu) cyangwa iy’Urusobe no kubungabunga (icyatsi). Uruhare rwawe rugomba kukwemerera gukoresha icyo gice.
start.step2: Iyo ari ubwa mbere uyishyiramo, andika ikigo, igihugu, ifaranga ry’ibanze n’ijambobanga rikomeye ry’umuyobozi. Nta jambobanga rusange ryashyizwemo.
start.step3: Injira ukoresheje izina ryawe bwite. Hitamo igice mu rutonde rw’ibumoso, uhindure ururimi hejuru. Sohoka mbere yo kuva kuri mudasobwa.

company.title: Ibigo n’abakoresha
company.intro: Amakuru y’ikigo arindwa hakurikijwe uburenganzira bw’umunyamuryango, si umutwe w’ubusabe waturutse ku mukiriya.
company.step1: Muri Igenamiterere, hindura amakuru y’ikigo cyangwa ukore ikindi kigo niba wemerewe. Ikigo gishya kigira konti zacyo; ntikimurirwamo amafaranga y’ikindi kigo.
company.step2: Mu kurema ikigo, hitamo igihugu n’ifaranga ry’ibanze. Amafaranga yemerewe: XAF, RWF, USD, EUR na UGX. Guhindura ifaranga ry’ibanze ry’ikigo gisanzwe birabujijwe kugira ngo amafaranga ya kera adahindurirwa igisobanuro.
company.step3: Muri Igenamiterere → Abakoresha, ha buri muntu konti n’uruhare bye. Muhe uburenganzira ku kigo mu buryo bweruye; mbere yo kwandika amakuru genzura ikigo cyatoranyijwe hejuru.

contacts.title: Abakiriya n’abagemura
contacts.intro: Amakuru y’umuntu umwe aba ay’ikigo kimwe.
contacts.step1: Fungura Abakiriya, ukande Ongeraho umukiriya. Andika izina n’andi makuru ufite. Fungura umurongo kugira ngo uhindure; soma ubutumwa niba kubika byanze.
contacts.step2: Mu gice cy’Umuyobozi, jya ku Bagemura → Ongeraho ugemura kugira ngo wandike abo mugurira. Umugurisha ntiyemererwa kubona abagemura.
contacts.step3: Guhagarika umuntu bimubuza gukoreshwa mu bikorwa bishya ariko inyemezabuguzi n’amateka bigasigara. Imyaka y’imyenda ibonwa n’abemerewe raporo.

products.title: Ibicuruzwa n’ububiko
products.intro: Igiciro cyo kugurisha n’ikiguzi cy’ububiko ni ibintu bitandukanye.
products.step1: Mu muyobozi → Ububiko, andika igicuruzwa gifite kode yihariye, izina, igiciro cyo kugurisha n’ikiguzi. Gihindurire aho; kugura, kugurisha cyangwa gukosora byemewe byandika uko ububiko buhindutse.
products.step2: Umugurisha → Ububiko herekana urutonde, umubare uhari n’ibiciro byo kugurisha, ntiherekana ikiguzi cyo kugura cyangwa agaciro k’ububiko. Imenyesha ry’ibisigaye bike rireba ikigo cyawe.
products.step3: Reba amateka y’ububiko mbere yo gukosora umubare. Inyemezabuguzi yemejwe igira ingaruka ku bubiko no mu gitabo cy’ibaruramari; ntusibe ibyanditswe bya kera ngo uhindure umubare.

sales.title: Uko kugurisha bikorwa
sales.intro: Inyemezabuguzi si kimwe no kwakira amafaranga.
sales.step1: Jya ku Byagurishijwe → Inyemezabuguzi, ukore inshya. Hitamo umukiriya, amatariki n’ibicuruzwa; genzura umubare, igiciro, igabanywa n’umusoro mbere yo kubika.
sales.step2: Kubyemeza ako kanya byandika mu ibaruramari no mu bubiko. Niba ubitse inyandiko itaremezwa, banza uyisuzume hanyuma uyemeze. Kuyemeza ubugira kabiri birangwa.
sales.step3: Koresha igikorwa cyo kwishyura wandike ubwishyu, harimo n’igice cy’ubwishyu. Capisha kopi nyuma yo kugenzura uko ihagaze n’imibare yose.
sales.step4: Ibyifuzo by’ibiciro n’amabwiriza yo kugura ni intambwe zitandukanye. Koresha inyandiko isubiza amafaranga mu gukosora cyangwa gusubiza ibicuruzwa byemewe; genzura niba bisubizwa mu bubiko.

purchases.title: Uko kugura bikorwa
purchases.intro: Byemerewe abafite uruhare rw’Umuyobozi gusa, si Umugurisha.
purchases.step1: Banza wandike ugemura. Mu Byaguzwe → Inyemezabuguzi, hitamo ugemura, amatariki, nimero y’inyemezabuguzi ye n’ibicuruzwa bifite ikiguzi n’imisoro.
purchases.step2: Genzura inyemezabuguzi mbere yo guhita uyemeza cyangwa wemeze inyandiko yari itarabyemezwa. Kwemeza byandika mu gitabo no mu bubiko aho bikenewe; kubisubiramo ntibikora indi nyandiko.
purchases.step3: Andika ubwishyu ukwabwo. Reba amabwiriza n’ibyasubijwe mu bice byabyo; genzura imyenda y’abagemura mbere yo gusoza igihe.

banking.title: Banki n’amafaranga mu ntoki
banking.intro: Ibikorwa bya banki n’amafaranga bireba ikigo kimwe.
banking.step1: Mu gice cya Banki, banza urebe konti n’amafaranga asigaye mbere yo kwandika ubwishyu cyangwa kwimura amafaranga. Hitamo ikigo n’inyandiko ngenderwaho nyayo.
banking.step2: Aho bishoboka, huza ubwishyu n’inyemezabuguzi yabwo. Genzura niba bwuzuye cyangwa ari igice, urebe amafaranga asigaye.
banking.step3: Gereranya ibyanditswe n’inyandiko ya banki ifatika; amafaranga yerekanwa kuri ecran si icyemezo ko banki yarangije kwimura amafaranga.

accounting.title: Ibaruramari ry’impande ebyiri
accounting.intro: Icyemejwe kigomba kugira imyenda n’inguzanyo bingana.
accounting.step1: Mu Ibaruramari, fungura urutonde rwa konti, uhitemo iz’ikigo urimo. Izina rya konti ryahinduwe mu rurimi ntirirema indi konti.
accounting.step2: Mu kwandika inyandiko y’ibaruramari, shyiramo itariki, ibisobanuro n’imirongo. Genzura ko imyenda n’inguzanyo bingana mbere yo kwemeza. Icyemejwe ntigihindurwa mu ibanga.
accounting.step3: Kosora ukoresheje inyandiko isubiza iyabanje ifite ibisobanuro aho gusiba amateka. Ongera ugenzure ibipimo by’imibare n’amateka y’ibyakozwe.

reports.title: Raporo no kugenzura
reports.intro: Raporo zerekana ibyemejwe mu kigo watoranyije.
reports.step1: Mu Raporo, reba ibipimo by’imibare cyangwa incamake y’imari. Gereranya igihe n’ifaranga n’inyandiko shingiro.
reports.step2: Niba imibare itari yo, genzura inyemezabuguzi zitaremezwa, ubwishyu butanditswe cyangwa niba wahinduye ikigo ukoreramo.
reports.step3: Ababifitiye uburenganzira gusa babona raporo zose z’imari n’imyaka y’imyenda. Imibare yoherejwe hanze igomba gusuzumwa n’umubaruramari.

backup.title: Kopi z’amakuru no kuyagarura
backup.intro: Hari uburyo bubiri: kopi JSON y’ikigo kimwe na kopi yuzuye ya SQLite kuri mudasobwa yakira serivisi.
backup.step1: Mu Muyobozi → Igenamiterere → Kopi, kuramo kopi y’ikigo, ubike indi ahandi hatari kuri iyi mudasobwa. Reba izina n’itariki. Amagambo banga n’amasomo yo kwinjira ntibirimo.
backup.step2: Mbere yo kugarura, genzura ikigo na dosiye. Andika ijambobanga ry’umuyobozi na RESTORE uko ryanditse. Sisitemu ibanza kugenzura umukono w’amakuru, ikigo, amasano n’uko ibaruramari ringana mbere yo guhindura.
backup.step3: Serivisi ibanza gukora kopi yuzuye yagenzuwe; nyuma yo kugarura buri wese asohoka. Ongera winjire, urebe inyemezabuguzi, amafaranga n’ububiko.
backup.step4: Mu gihe habaye ikibazo gikomeye, banza ufunge porogaramu, usabe umutekinisiye wizewe kugarura kopi ya SQLite yagenzuwe. Ntukimure dosiye .db yonyine serivisi ikora.

network.title: Imikorere no kubungabunga
network.intro: Igice cy’icyatsi kigenzura serivisi y’iyi mudasobwa. Ntigiha abakozi ba tekiniki uburenganzira ku makuru y’ubucuruzi.
network.step1: Injira ufite uruhare rw’Urusobe (cyangwa uri umuyobozi). Genzura imikorere urebe serivisi, ubuziranenge bwa SQLite n’uko amasano y’amakuru agenzurwa.
network.step2: Kora kopi yagenzuwe kugira ngo ubike kopi yuzuye ya SQLite mu bubiko bw’iyi mudasobwa. Andika izina ryayo; uyimure ahandi ukoresheje uburenganzira bwemewe bwa sisitemu.
network.step3: Umuyobozi gusa ni we ushobora gukuramo cyangwa kugarura kopi y’ikigo hano. Umukoresha w’Urusobe ntabona ibicuruzwa, abakiriya, konti cyangwa raporo z’imari.
network.step4: Iyi verisiyo ntifungura serivisi kuri LAN. Ntugasangize cyangwa ngo uhuze dosiye za SQLite hagati ya mudasobwa; koresha serivisi y’iyi mudasobwa kugeza uburyo bwizewe bwo guhuza buje.

safety.title: Amagambo banga n’umutekano
safety.intro: Bika amakuru yo kwinjira na kopi z’ububiko ahizewe, hatandukanye na mudasobwa ukoresha.
safety.step1: Ntugasangize abandi konti cyangwa ijambobanga. Iyo kunjira byanze kenshi, bishobora gufungwa by’igihe gito. Niba umuyobozi wenyine yibagiwe, koresha uburyo bwo kugarura bwemewe.
safety.step2: Mbere yo kuvugurura cyangwa gukuraho porogaramu, kora kopi, ugenzure ko amakuru asomwa. Amakuru ari mu bubiko bw’umukoresha, si mu bubiko bw’aho porogaramu yashyizwe.
safety.step3: Ibi bice bitatu bikoresha serivisi imwe. Ntugahindurire dosiye ya SQLite mu yindi porogaramu JENESIS igikora.

limits.title: Ibitarakorwa
limits.intro: JENESIS 0.1 ni verisiyo ya mbere itarashyirwaho umukono. Banza ugenzure ibisubizo mbere yo kubishingiraho.
limits.step1: Amafaranga yemewe akoreshwa nk’ifaranga ry’ibanze ryihariye rya buri kigo, si uguhinduranya amafaranga byikora. Guhindura agaciro k’ivunjisha ryo mu bihe byashize ntibiragenzurwa.
limits.step2: Kwakira abandi kuri LAN, gukorera hamwe kure, kopi zihita zibikwa ahandi n’uburyo bwikora bwo kugarura amakuru ntibirimo. Ugomba kubika kopi hanze ubwawe.
limits.step3: Kugeragereza ishyirwamo kuri sisitemu ya Windows yo mu igerageza si icyemezo ko bikora kuri PC yawe, mu kuvugurura, kuri antivirusi cyangwa nta murongo wa interineti. Baza umubaruramari ibyerekeye imisoro.
limits.step4: Kuri XAF, RWF na UGX, amafaranga afite ibice by’ifaranga arangwa aho guhishwa n’uko ecran yerekana imibare yuzuye. Kosora inyandiko wemeranyije n’umubaruramari; uburyo bwo kwegeranya amafaranga bwemewe n’amategeko y’aho ukorera ntiburagenzurwa.
